result:
PERF-13c-i is implemented and ready for C. I did not open a browser, so none of the browser rows (S1–S11, PERF-RES, AUTH) has been checked yet. My report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-393.md`.

**What changed:** previewing a URL source that isn't cached (the two demo MP3s in `/studio-lab`) now plays through a plain `<audio>` element. There is no `decodeAudioData` call and no added decoded audio in memory. Cached and synth sources still use the old buffer path. If the stream fails, the preview falls back to the old decode path from the same second, and that source is not streamed again in this collection.

**Files:** only the 7 granted paths changed: 5 modified, plus the new test file and doc 252. Protected files are 11/11 unchanged and the frozen manifest has 0 failures.

**Checks run:**
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and Biome on the 6 changed code and test files: all rc 0.
- Covering test set: 14 files, 247 tests, all pass. No test is above 50 % of its timeout.
- All 15 test rows PS1–PS15 are written. Unlike B's sketch, the tests use no type assertions.
- Mutants: 17 of 17 fail at their named row, and the unmodified code passes. That is the 16 from the task plus one I added.
- I did not run the full suite, `verify` or the build; the gate does.

**Code review:** the `code-reviewer` subagent scored it 8/10 with no Critical or High findings.
- **M2:** nothing tested a `play()` rejection on an active stream. I added that check to PS4, and its mutant fails as expected. A second review of that change said "delta OK".
- **M1:** if the OS or media keys pause the audio, the toggle still shows Stop, and seeking does not resume playback. B already ruled this as sketch-review #4, a deferred Low. I did not change it because the fix would alter the agreed behaviour. B should re-rate it.
- The Lows and an architecture note are in the report. One Low matters for the next stage (13c-ii): its signed URLs change on every call, so every seek would reload the file.

**Three claim values changed that the task's §7 list doesn't allow:**

| Claim | Before → now | Why |
|---|---|---|
| K13 | 6 → 7 | Comes from B's own sketch |
| K15 | the new test file joins the list | Comes from B's own sketch |
| K22 | 5 → 6 | Required by §3's doc status line |

I proved the K13 and K15 values by running the claims script on a scratch copy with the sketch applied. The task's list was typed by hand rather than taken from that run. I reported these for B and C rather than stopping the round.

**One small difference from the sketch:** I moved the cache check into an `isCached` variable. Behaviour is identical, and it keeps claim K8 at its planned value of 1, which the sketch would have raised to 2.

PERF-13c-ii, the second stage, is still open, so I marked nothing in the backlog complete.
